analysis.assertion_strategy: Wait for 증권정보, 현재가, and the six-digit ticker before extraction; assert structured output keys company_name, ticker, current_price, report_text instead of exact volatile prices.
extraction_tips: Prefer naver_stock.extract_stock_card with page_text, company_name, ticker.
Treat current price and market status as volatile; validate key presence and ticker identity.
risk_notes: Naver search result cards can reorder sections and price text changes during market hours.
Direct DOM class selectors are brittle on Naver search; text markers and handler extraction are more stable.
analysis.selector_strategy: Use direct search URL and stable visible text markers before taking body text; avoid depending on generated class names.
analysis.summary: Naver stock search card for 카카오 with stable stock markers.

analysis.assertion_strategy: Use browser evaluation for headed map workflows and assert that a transit result exposes duration text plus route mode markers.
extraction_tips: Prefer naver_map.extract_subway_duration after the result page has settled.
Collect body text after route result rendering; initial page text can be empty before the app hydrates.
risk_notes: Naver Map is a hydrated app and may keep useful UI text out of initial static body text.
Route panels can be rendered after map scripts and iframe-like internal layers finish loading.
analysis.selector_strategy: Open the directions transit URL, then use accessible/text input affordances for 출발/도착 fields under browser evaluation.
analysis.summary: Naver Map transit directions requires browser-evaluated interaction, not static page_text assertions.

analysis.assertion_strategy: After submit, assert Secure Area, You logged into a secure area, and Logout markers rather than depending on exact flash CSS.
extraction_tips: Use role/label selectors for Username and Password; the form is simple enough to avoid CSS selectors.
Report visible success text and current URL path /secure.
risk_notes: The flash message includes a close button and whitespace changes; compare contains markers instead of exact full text.
analysis.selector_strategy: Use get_by_label('Username'), get_by_label('Password'), and get_by_role('button', name='Login').
analysis.summary: Herokuapp login page has stable labels and a reliable secure-area success marker.
